verdict: Cost per lead fell sharply; open setup items must close before scaling.
narrative: This period your cost per lead dropped 87% week-over-week to $91.55, driven by 18 leads from Meta at a markedly lower cost as spend increased. That burst was concentrated in early October and has since leveled off, so the lower cost per lead reflects a real efficiency gain but not a sustained new run rate yet. Nine planned milestones — including heating campaign activation, booking system testing, and intake confirmation — are overdue, and those items are the explicit gate on any budget scale-up. We are working through that milestone list now so the account is ready to expand once they are cleared. Next period, expect steadier lead flow as heating campaigns come fully online and the remaining setup items are resolved.
